why: TLS with every option of Remnawave: pins, other names, ECH, cipher suites.

singbox.why: Remnawave's sing-box generator (singbox.generator.service.ts) writes the pins as tls.insecure and drops verifyPeerCertByName; the link (pcs, vcn) and the Xray JSON verify the certificate. The server of the sing-box JSON is noted as not verified.

xray.why: The Xray JSON has the host's echConfigList; Remnawave's links carry no ECH (xray.generator.service.ts), and its sing-box JSON drops it.
